INSERT INTO value_fundamental ( effective_date, stock_code, sector, per, pbr, eps, bps, div_yield, market_cap, shares_outstanding, trading_value, per_pct, pbr_pct, value_score, scored_scope, eps_growth, value_trap ) VALUES
( #{i.effectiveDate}, #{i.stockCode}, #{i.sector}, #{i.per}, #{i.pbr}, #{i.eps}, #{i.bps}, #{i.divYield}, #{i.marketCap}, #{i.sharesOutstanding}, #{i.tradingValue}, #{i.perPct}, #{i.pbrPct}, #{i.valueScore}, #{i.scoredScope}, #{i.epsGrowth}, #{i.valueTrap} )
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sector = new.sector, per = new.per, pbr = new.pbr, eps = new.eps, bps = new.bps, div_yield = new.div_yield, market_cap = new.market_cap, shares_outstanding = new.shares_outstanding, trading_value = new.trading_value, per_pct = new.per_pct, pbr_pct = new.pbr_pct, value_score = new.value_score, scored_scope = new.scored_scope, eps_growth = new.eps_growth, value_trap = new.value_trap
